mapper.select: SELECT s.DEVICE_ID, s.CREATE_DATE, s.TEMP_C, s.HUMIDITY, s.SOIL_MOISTURE_VALUE, s.LDR_VALUE, s.FAN_STATUS, s.LED_STATUS, s.PUMP_STATUS, t.CROPS, t.TEMP_MIN, t.TEMP_MAX, t.SOIL_MIN, t.SOIL_MAX, t.LUX_MIN, t.LUX_MAX FROM SENSOR_DATA s LEFT JOIN DEVICE_INFO d ON s.DEVICE_ID = d.DEVICE_ID LEFT JOIN DEVICE_ACTUATOR_STANDARD t ON d.CROPS = t.CROPS WHERE s.ID = ( SELECT MAX(ID) FROM SENSOR_DATA WHERE DEVICE_ID = s.DEVICE_ID ) ORDER BY s.CREATE_DATE DESC
